setup: CSTR single loop: scaffolded LLM iteratively proposes PI gains with closed-loop cost feedback
C1_note: relay-feedback ZN (tuned auto-tuner) and multi-start optimum (p.12)
C3_note: nominal set-point tracking only; deterministic sim (p.27)
C4_note: multiple seeds ('never better across seeds') but no spread for CSTR; model/settings given (p.12, p.27)
C5_note: no rate of LLM decision quality on CSTR (p.12)
key_result: Scaffolded LLM reached IAE 0.162 vs relay-ZN 0.106 (optimum 0.102), about 50% worse (p.12).
limitation: Evidence limited to 2x2/3x3 PI plants in deterministic simulation; no stability margins or hardware (p.25).

setup: Quadruple-tank 2x2: scaffolded LLM proposes PI gains over 18 rounds, then Nelder-Mead refines (hybrid)
C1_note: relay-ZN, NM, LHS-NM, DE, BO, decoupler, grid and VRFT; VRFT beats hybrid (p.6, p.19-21)
C2_note: J=IAE+0.75TV, IAE, TV, success rate, evaluations (p.6, p.19)
C3_note: no disturbance/mismatch; only lambda sweep and noise on LLM prior (p.24-25)
C4_note: 10 seeds, SD reported; verbatim prompt, Qwen3-14B, T=0.9, p=0.95 (p.5, p.16)
C5_note: 10/10 seeds in J<20 region; neutral-prompt ablation 0/5 strongly asymmetric (p.16, p.23)
C6_note: gain clip and JSON retry only; never challenged, clip never approached (p.27)
loop_timing: 120 control steps over 400 s episode; LLM offline, 18 rounds per run (p.5)
key_result: Hybrid reached J 12.0 +/- 0.16 (10/10) vs naive NM 0/10, but VRFT+refinement reached J 11.12 +/- 0.05 (10/10) at lower cost (p.16, p.20).
limitation: Reliability largely due to JSON format example anchoring structure; neutral prompt gave J 13.86 +/- 1.69 (p.23).

setup: Synthetic 3x3 cyclic coupled plant: scaffolded LLM gains plus Nelder-Mead refinement
C1_note: DE (10 runs per budget), naive NM 20 starts, inverse-gain heuristic; no VRFT (p.19-20, p.22)
C4_note: 10 seeds with SD and range; plant fully specified (p.19)
C5_note: 9/10 seeds below success threshold after refinement (p.19)
loop_timing: dt=0.2 s, 120 steps; LLM offline, 18 rounds (p.19)
key_result: Hybrid J 2.17 +/- 0.11 in 9/10 runs at about 294 evaluations vs about 2400 for DE, roughly 8x fewer (p.19-20).
limitation: VRFT not re-run at 3x3, so margin vs data-driven tuning unknown (p.20, p.25).

setup: Quadruple-tank: LLM proposes VRFT reference time constant tau from rise-time summaries, then refinement
C1_note: 11-point tau grid scan and median rise-time rule; median rule wins (p.21)
C2_note: J after refinement, paired Wilcoxon tests (p.21)
C4_note: 10 open-loop seeds, SD; 2500-token budget, 3 resamples, model named (p.21, p.27)
C5_note: committed tau in 8/10 seeds; all 8 in safe range 70-100 s (p.21)
C6_note: no gate; uncommitted outputs counted as failures (p.21)
key_result: LLM tau gave J 11.19 +/- 0.17 in 8/10 seeds vs median rule 10/10 at J 11.17 +/- 0.15 (p=0.69) (p.21).
limitation: Median rule matches LLM quality and beats its reliability at no cost; LLM not credited (p.21-22).
